classification: single-run coding-agent workload comparison on one MI50; not a parity test of the whole engine

source.image: strata-gfx906:0.2.2-repack-native-local (docker/gfx906/Dockerfile, STRATA_PORTABLE=OFF, built on the measuring host)

environment.hardware_class: one AMD Instinct MI50 32 GB (gfx906), Ryzen 9 7945HX (Zen 4, AVX-512), 59 GB RAM
environment.model_assets: external Swift Qwen3.8 Flash-Next GSQ-RCO IQ3_S assets; not distributed
environment.config: one slot, --max-context 262144, int8 KV, --spec 3 with the MTP draft layer, --prefill auto:32768, adaptive tier tuned, gfx906 attention switches, CPU vision; expert cache 11636 slots in every arm

workload: tools/agent_turns_bench.py sessions through the tuning harness's agent_bench.py: one agent (8 turns), then two simultaneous agents (8 turns); temperature 1, top-p 0.95, top-k 20, fixed seed, reasoning high, 256 tokens per turn. The grep tool results were empty in all arms (the source checkout used had no git metadata), identically for every arm.

parity_checks.rp_expert_bench: 0 failures; repacked IQ4_NL expert products bitwise equal to MMQ, 23-81% faster per product
parity_checks.dense_mmq_bench_T4096: int8 dense products 46-74% faster than dequant + hipBLAS FP16; IQ4_XS repack bitwise equal to MMQ; Q6_K / Q5_K repack differ from MMQ in summation order with the same error against an FP64 reference (5.3e-3 / 1.1e-2); the FP16 path's error is 2.9e-4
parity_checks.engine_STRATA_PF_RP_CHECK: 2000 repacked products compared against MMQ on a 15,000-token prompt of the real model: 0 differ

limitations: One run per arm; the drift control reproduced its earlier run within 1% on prefill and exactly on the one-agent time.
The port's decode (59.1 against 57.8 tok/s median, means 58.4 against 58.6) does not show a measurable gain from the AVX-512 build on this workload.
The Q6_K / Q5_K dense repack and the int8 dense path are not bit-identical to the FP16 prompt path; draft acceptance did not drop here.
No sustained-load, long-context (above about 50K tokens) or batch-slot measurement of the port.
